package: UROPS 2026 convergence-figure data (ABF vs ABF + marginal Fisher-Rao birth-death)
statistic: median and 25th / 75th percentiles across seeds at every saved checkpoint

gateway.title: Entropic gateway (histogram ABF vs ABF + uniform FR), validated timestep
gateway.status: original data, post-processing only (no new simulation)

config.estimator: P0 histogram, own-bin bias Gamma_j = M_j / (C_j + 1), no ABF ramp
config.fr: uniform target on [-1.8, 1.8]; binned reflect-padded Gaussian KDE eta = 0.1; score clip 3; rate g(t) = 1.5 (1 - exp(-t / 4)); FR every 0.004 t.u. (160 steps) from t = 0, never stopped; cap max(1, floor(0.08 N)) = 163 events per opportunity
config.init: x ~ N(-1, 0.05) in the left well, y from the exact conditional; identical for both arms
config.pairing: identical Langevin noise slot by slot (separate FR stream); both arms bitwise identical only for ABF; FR acts from the first opportunity

gateway.reference: exact analytic F(x) = H (x^2-1)^2 + log(omega(x))/beta + C and F'(x) (frozen results/equal_budget_v2/references/gateway_reference.npz, sha256 recorded by the scorer)

definitions.eF: RMS over the 151 eval-window nodes x in [-1.5, 1.5] of F_hat - F_ref after removing the mean difference (additive-constant alignment, uniform weight); F_hat = exact integral of the piecewise-constant bin force
definitions.eFp: L2 over [-1.5, 1.5] (Gauss-Legendre sub-grid per bin) of Gamma_j - F'_ref(x); includes the hard piecewise-constant floor 0.0323 (within-bin variation of F'_ref at the gate): e_F'^2 = stat^2 + floor^2
definitions.exi: ||p_t - u||_L2 on [-1.8, 1.8], p_t = instantaneous replica histogram / (N * 0.02), u = 1/3.6

units.exi: density per unit x (L2 norm, units x^-1/2)

gateway.integrated_definition: Ibar_F = mean of e_F over the 200 uniform budget fractions u = k/200 (frozen eqb_metrics)

floors.exi_floor_definition: RMS of ||p_hat - u|| for N independent exactly-uniform walkers

lta150.title: Ethane in rigid all-silica LTA, 150 K (histogram ABF vs ABF + uniform FR)
lta150.status: original data, post-processing only (no new simulation)

source.not_read: fr_sham.npz (historical matched-sham arm; not part of this two-arm comparison)

config.estimator: P0 histogram on 180 circular bins (own-bin bias M_j / C_j, 0 on empty bins); ABF bias ramp over 0 <= t <= 4; reported estimator from production accumulators after the estimator burn-in at t = 4 (all-steps accumulators before)
config.fr: uniform target 1/(2 pi); wrapped-Gaussian KDE bandwidth 0.1 rad; score clip 2.0; rate 0.2; every 5 steps from t = 4; never stopped; cap floor(0.02 N) = 20 events per opportunity
config.pairing: all arms of one temperature in ONE process on common seeds (rng_seed 20260902)

lta150.reference: independent exact Metropolis MC umbrella reference (results/numerical_validation/lta/T150/MC, 640 chain files): F = MC density route (summary.json profiles['MC density']), F' = pooled MC bin conditional mean force

definitions.eF: sqrt(mean_j (F_hat_j - F_ref_j - c)^2) over the 180 bins, c = mean difference (full circle, uniform)
definitions.eFp: sqrt(mean_j (Gamma_j - F'_ref_j)^2) over the 180 bins (full circle, uniform); per-bin reference, no deterministic within-bin floor
definitions.exi: ||p_hat_t - u||_L2 over the circle, p_hat_t = saved KDE (bandwidth 0.1 rad) of the current replica phi values, normalised to integrate to 1 over [-pi, pi), u = 1/(2 pi)

units.t: engine time units (overdamped EM, dt = 2e-4 per step; not physical ps)

lta150.marginal_type: instantaneous replica marginal, KDE-smoothed (bandwidth 0.1 rad) as saved by the engine; not a raw histogram
lta150.integrated_definition: I_F = trapezoid of e_F over all saves on [0, 60] (LTA_VALIDATION / analyze_lta_histogram); atlas Ibar = I / T and post-ramp Ibar over [t_FR, T] also reproduced

ite300.title: Ethane in rigid Si-ITE (ITQ-3), 300 K: early-stopping FR (confirmatory block E1)
ite300.status: original data, post-processing only (no new simulation)

config.estimator: P0 histogram on 180 circular bins from step 0, deposit before read, bias = ramp(t) * min(1, C_j / 200.0) * M_j / C_j; ramp over 0 <= t <= 1
config.fr: uniform target; unnormalised wrapped-Gaussian KDE bandwidth 0.1 rad; score clip 2.0 (recentred score, lta_ladder_numba._fr_score); rate 2.0; every 10 steps from t = 1 to t = 10 (fr_stop_steps 100000), plain ABF afterwards; cap max(1, floor(0.02 N)) = 20 per opportunity
config.init: cage (50000 equilibration steps, excluded from the budget)
config.pairing: shared PCG64 streams for initial conditions and Langevin noise; arms bitwise identical before the first FR opportunity (asserted)

ite300.reference: exact Metropolis MC reference results/overnight/ite/reference (variant ite_itq3), mapped to the 180-bin grid by src/eri/metrics.reference_for_grid (F and per-bin mean force)

definitions.eF: aligned full-circle RMS over the 180 bins of F_hat - F_ref (mean difference removed), uniform weight
definitions.eFp: RMS over the 180 bins of Gamma_j - F'_ref_j (uniform weight)
definitions.exi: ||p_t - u||_L2 over the circle, p_t = sv_h / (N * 2 pi / 180) the instantaneous histogram of the current replicas, u = 1/(2 pi)

units.t: engine time units (overdamped EM, dt = 1e-4 per step)

ite300.integrated_definition: post-ramp Ibar_F = (1/(T - t_FR)) * trapezoid of e_F over [t_FR, T] = [1, 50] (prereg companion); S_geo = per-seed geometric mean over the kT ladder {0.080, 0.064, 0.048, 0.040, 0.032} kT of min(tau_ABF, T) / min(tau_FR, T) (sustained), median over seeds on the log scale with a 10000-resample bootstrap CI

meta.title: Energetic metastability toy (2-D Gaussian-quartic multiwell, xi = x, beta = 4): histogram ABF vs ABF + uniform FR
meta.status: NEW simulation (the only rerun of this package): timestep gate, ABF-only resolution pilot, safety-only FR-rate pilot, then 32 fresh paired confirmation seeds

source.archived_study: results/two_dim_xi_x/, report/sections/04_case_metastability.tex (kernel-type ABF, 5 exploratory seeds; NOT used)

config.estimator: P0 histogram, 120 bins on [-3, 3], own-bin bias M_j / (C_j + 1), deposit before read, no ramp
config.fr: uniform target 1/6 on [-3, 3]; binned reflect-padded Gaussian KDE eta = 0.1; score clip 2.0; rate r(t) = 0.2 (1 - exp(-t / 20.0)); FR every 0.01 t.u. from t = 0; never stopped; cap max(1, floor(0.02 N)) = 20 per opportunity; deaths ~ S+, sources ~ S-
config.init: mixed (archived): half of the walkers U[-2.4, -0.6] x U[-1.9, -0.1], half U[0.6, 2.4] x U[1.1, 2.9]
config.pairing: identical initial conditions and Langevin noise slot by slot (separate FR stream); bitwise identical until the first FR death (asserted)

meta.reference: independent y-quadrature (src/abffr/reference.compute_reference) on 6001 x nodes x 2001 y nodes; checked against 4001 y nodes and the archived 801-node profile

definitions.eF: centred domain-RMS on [-2.5, 2.5] (trapezoid on 2001 nodes, node-mean removed) of F_hat - F_ref, F_hat = exact integral of the piecewise-constant Gamma (archived metrics.l2_error_F convention)
definitions.eFp: domain-RMS on [-2.5, 2.5] of Gamma(x) - F'_ref(x), no centring (archived metrics.l2_error_Fprime); includes the piecewise-constant floor 0.1387
definitions.exi: ||p_t - u||_L2 on [-3, 3], p_t = instantaneous replica histogram on the 120 ABF bins / (N * 0.05), u = 1/6

units.exi: density per unit x (L2 norm, x^-1/2)

domain.exi: [-3, 3] (full reflecting x domain = FR target domain)

meta.integrated_definition: I_F = trapezoid of e_F over [0, T] (archived integrated_l2_over_time); paired per-seed relative change, median, 10000-resample percentile bootstrap CI of the median (seed 20261020)

alanine.title: Alanine dipeptide in vacuum, (phi, psi): adaptive-box histogram ABF vs ABF + uniform FR
alanine.status: original data, post-processing only (no new simulation)

config.estimator: adaptive-box histogram ABF: per cell, the smallest centred box of (2l+1)^2 cells, l = 0..4, holding >= c_min = 800 counts gives the mean force; 5 ps bias ramp; projected to a gradient field every 50 steps (the reported pmf)
config.fr: uniform target on the full torus 1/(2 pi)^2; product wrapped-Gaussian KDE bandwidth 0.15 rad; score clip 2; rate 0.02; every 500 steps (0.5 ps) from t = 20 ps; never stopped; cap floor(0.05 N) = 102 per opportunity
config.pairing: same cached initial ensemble, same dynamical noise stream and rng_seed 20260903 for both stages

alanine.reference: umbrella sampling (24 x 24 windows x 16 copies, kappa 200) + MBAR on the 97 x 97 grid (results/alanine/reference/reference.npz); non-finite in never-visited cells; bootstrap noise floor of the e_F read-out 0.559 kJ/mol

definitions.eF: min_c sqrt(sum_ij w_ij (F_hat - F_ref - c)^2), w = exp(-(F_ref - F_min)/kT) normalised on the 8 kT mask {F_ref - F_min <= 8 kT} (equilibrium weight; metrics_ala.aligned_l2, the study's raw read-out)
definitions.eFp: sqrt(sum_ij w_ij |grad F_hat - grad F_ref|^2) with periodic central differences on the torus for both, same weight w (metrics_ala.grad_errors; cells whose stencil touches a non-finite F_ref excluded)
definitions.exi: ||p_t - u||_L2 over the full torus, p_t = marg_hist / dz^2 (instantaneous histogram of the current replicas), u = 1/(2 pi)^2

alanine.weighting: equilibrium (Boltzmann) weight of the reference on the 8 kT mask for e_F and e_F'; uniform for e_xi
alanine.marginal_type: instantaneous replica histogram (raw, unsmoothed), 97 x 97 cells; float32 storage
alanine.integrated_definition: dI_F = paired relative change of the trapezoid of e_F over the own window [20, 100] ps (the study's frozen primary window [max(t_FR, 1), 100] ps); median with a BCa bootstrap CI (metrics_ala.paired_bootstrap)

exi_kde.definition: ||p_kde - u||_L2 on the full torus, p_kde = the FR arm's own marginal estimator (d2.kde2: saved instantaneous cell histogram smoothed by the 0.15 rad wrapped-Gaussian kernels, normalised); KDE-SMOOTHED, not the primary panel; resolves the steric floor that the raw 97 x 97 histogram hides under its finite-N floor

floors.eFp_reference_noise_definition: sqrt(sum w Var(grad F_ref)) with Var from the bootstrap s.e. of F_ref (results/alanine/reference/bootstrap.npz) through the central difference, treating cells as independent (no bootstrap replicates are stored, so neighbour correlations cannot be included: an INDICATIVE scale, not a bound); the e_F' endpoints of both arms (about 8.25) are of this size, i.e. e_F' is limited by the reference's own cell noise and cannot separate the arms

exi.definition: L2_floor = min ||p - u|| over densities supported on the set S = sqrt(1/|S| - 1/|Z|) (attained by the uniform density on S); L2_floor_incl_finite_N adds the multinomial scatter of N independent walkers uniform on S, (1 - 1/n_S)/(N dz^2)

wca.title: WCA dimer in WCA solvent at the validated timestep (histogram ABF vs ABF + uniform FR)
wca.status: original data, post-processing only (no new simulation)

source.not_exported: hist_fr_sham (matched-turnover sham, historical); the invalid dt = 0.002 positive runs

config.estimator: P0 histogram on 160 bins of [-0.2, 1.2] (own-bin bias M_j / C_j, edge-extrapolated); linear ABF ramp over 0 <= t <= 20; reported estimator = all-steps accumulators until the estimator burn-in at t = 20, production accumulators (deposits from t = 20) afterwards
config.fr: uniform target on [-0.2, 1.2]; reflected Gaussian KDE bandwidth 0.07; score clip 2.0; rate 0.1 (no ramp); every 80 steps (0.01 t.u.) from t = 40; never stopped; cap floor(0.02 N) = 5 per opportunity
config.pairing: ABF and FR arms on the same Langevin noise (separate processes); identical accumulators before t = 40 (asserted)

wca.reference: exact Gibbs by Metropolis MC (64 chains): F = density route, F' = MC bin conditional means, interpolated to the 160-node scorer grid (rescore_wca_history.mc_reference)

definitions.eF: RMS on the eval window [-0.1, 1.1] of the reported pmf minus F_ref after removing the mean difference (core.timeseries_l2; additive-constant alignment, uniform weight)
definitions.eFp: histogram_fp_error_np: L2 over [-0.1, 1.1] of the bin mean force Gamma_j vs the MC mean force (the histogram arms' own e_F', the confirmatory's primary F' metric)

units.exi: density per unit z (L2 norm, z^-1/2)

wca.integrated_definition: I_F = trapezoid of e_F over all saves on [0, 240] (wca_numba integrated_l2_f); paired per-seed % change, median with a 10000-resample bootstrap CI (analyze_wca_confirmatory.contrast)

exi_interior.definition: ||p - u|| over the 158 interior bins only (renormalised on [-0.19125, 1.19125], u = 1/1.3825): removes the edge-bin spikes from the replicas held in the soft-wall tails; diagnostic, not the primary panel
